params.name: dag_id
params.description: If set, only return DAG warnings with this dag_id.

params.name: warning_type
params.description: If set, only return DAG warnings with this type.

params.name: limit
params.description: The numbers of items to return.

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of items to skip before starting to collect the result set.

params.name: order_by
params.description:
The name of the field to order the results by.
Prefix a field name with `-` to reverse the sort order.

*New in version 2.1.0*
